About.title: Developing endurance sports in Ridder
About.intro: Peloton Ridder is a sports club founded in 2019 to promote running, skiing and mass participation sport among young people in Ridder and East Kazakhstan. We organise four races a year across different terrain — from city distances to mountain trails — aiming to make participation accessible to newcomers and rewarding for experienced athletes.
